assay_authenticity_and_target.target: Pyruvate formation by purified wild-type Cdc19, detected through coupled lactate dehydrogenase/NADH oxidation
assay_authenticity_and_target.native_claim_limit: Wild-type yeast enzyme sequence is relevant, but this is recombinant, Strep-tagged in-vitro material, not a protein preparation from native yeast cells or an in-vivo enzyme flux.
assay_authenticity_and_target.measured_readout_unit_as_reported: Decrease in absorbance at 340 nm per minute
assay_authenticity_and_target.not_model_or_simulation: The primary methods describe reaction initiation and detector readings over time; Figure 2A is a measured activity assay, not model output.
assay_authenticity_and_target.scope: A limited activity contrast at specified inputs. Not a multidimensional substrate/regulator kinetic law, and not intrinsic kcat.

preparation_and_inputs.construct: Wild-type Cdc19-Strep; mutant constructs are present elsewhere in the paper but are not interchangeable native wild-type observations
preparation_and_inputs.purification: Strep-Tactin Superflow Plus affinity purification, fraction checks by SDS-PAGE/Coomassie, pooling and frozen aliquots
preparation_and_inputs.temperature_warning: 42 C is the pretreatment temperature. Do not infer that the activity readout was performed at 42 C or at the yeast growth temperature.
preparation_and_inputs.independently_varied_substrate_or_regula: None established: Figure 2A uses fixed PEP/ADP and does not report an FBP titration.
preparation_and_inputs.other_FBP_experiments: FBP doses elsewhere address aggregation, binding, re-solubilization or localization, not a matched activity-versus-FBP initial-rate table. They cannot be relabelled as catalytic response measurements.

source_discrepancy_and_correction.resolution: Unresolved; preserve both descriptions and obtain source-author clarification before fixing the assay domain.

correction.title: Author Correction: Reversible amyloids of pyruvate kinase couple cell metabolism and stress granule disassembly
correction.bibliographic_relation: Europe PMC core metadata identifies Erratum for PMID 34616026
correction.access_probe: HTTP 200 text/html Client Challenge, not a PDF; no challenge bypass attempted
correction.warning: Do not assume that the correction resolves the 30-versus-60-minute discrepancy; correction content has not been read.

replication_and_randomization.randomization_evidence: Statistics and Reproducibility explicitly states that the experiments were not randomized and investigators were not blinded to allocation/outcome assessment.
replication_and_randomization.other_reporting: No sample-size predetermination, no outlier tests and no data excluded are stated.
replication_and_randomization.hierarchy_warning: Three author-labelled independent experiments are not verified as three independent expression cultures or purifications. Two treatment aliquots can share a preparation and calibration. Shared preparation is a nuisance dependency, not automatically a duplicate reaction, but neither aliquots nor time points add biological N.

source_data_availability.article_statement: Numerical source data giving rise to graphical representations, with all independent repeats, and unprocessed gel/blot images are reported in Source Data files.

activity_attachment.head_interpretation: HTML response, not a verified XLSX download. Attachment existence is source-linked; downloadable workbook contents remain unverified.
activity_attachment.expected_observation_level_from_caption_: Per-experiment absorbance-change slopes for the two Figure 2A states; workbook also covers other Figure 2 panels. Do not infer a raw time-course matrix from the phrase source data.

official_europe_pmc_bulk_endpoint.interpretation: Documented supplement endpoint advertises a ZIP. A HEAD response with no body does not verify member bytes, integrity or raw observations; retrieval is deferred until the new claim/registration/access boundary is resolved.

source_data_availability.attachment_count_meaning: Includes figure source spreadsheets, unprocessed gels/blots, peer review and strain/plasmid tables. It is not an assay or replicate count.

normalization_and_identifiability.activity_processing: Figure 2A reports an absorbance-versus-time slope. Original time windows, baseline/blank subtraction, path length and calibration uncertainty were not verified.
normalization_and_identifiability.no_response_normalization_imported: No ATP/ADP, normalized image intensity, relative aggregation or growth data are imported as activity labels.
normalization_and_identifiability.denominator_limit: Nominal purified protein mass is known, but active enzyme fraction and the active concentration after heat-induced aggregation are not independently identified. Dividing by total protein or fitting a gain cannot establish intrinsic kcat.
normalization_and_identifiability.form_identifiability: A two-state experiment at fixed substrate concentrations cannot identify substrate/regulator functional dependence. Adding time points from the same detector trace does not create an independently controlled substrate titration.

orthogonal_support_and_holdout.limits: These support structural/state/physiological context, not an independent matched measure of Cdc19 catalytic rate. The ATP/ADP pool ratio is not a flux. Culture/preparation pairing and error dependence are not established here.
orthogonal_support_and_holdout.legitimate_future_reservation: Unexposed complete source experiment/preparation IDs and all their treatment aliquots; hypothetical well/timepoint splits cannot be labelled biological holdouts. This source's explicit non-randomization and small stated N must remain visible.

decision: A genuine, source-linked Cdc19 activity assay suitable as a lead for narrowly scoped replication/support. Not eligible for rate-law functional-form learning; source-data integrity, assay-domain discrepancy, preparation identities, calibration and new registration are unresolved.
